high_risk_actions.risk_reason: Declining client work can affect reputation, relationship capital, money, and future opportunity.

levels.authority: May formulate a recommendation only; operator approval is required before any client-facing decline.
levels.unlock_condition: Default starting state for every domain.

levels.authority: May decline only if the case exactly matches an approved low-risk precedent and the Advice_Integrity_Receipt passes all required fields.
levels.unlock_condition: Requires 5 approved Level 1 decline recommendations in the same domain, no operator reversals, and matching verified constraints.

levels.authority: May decline within a mature, bounded domain with logged evidence and after Guardian confirms no manipulative or evasive framing.
levels.unlock_condition: Requires 10 successful Level 2 executions in the same domain, no operator override, and explicit Master promotion.

high_risk_actions.risk_reason: Parking operator work can hide obligations or deadlines if trust is granted too early.

levels.authority: May recommend parking or dropping a task; operator or Master confirmation is required.
levels.unlock_condition: Default starting state for every task family.

levels.authority: May park only low-risk tasks that match approved precedent and have no deadline, send, money, Legal, or client-visible consequence.
levels.unlock_condition: Requires 5 approved Level 1 park recommendations for that task family and no later recovery request.

levels.authority: May park mature low-risk task families with audit trail, recovery path, and operator-visible summary.
levels.unlock_condition: Requires 10 successful Level 2 parks, no missed deadline, no hidden client obligation, and explicit Master promotion.
